source: Exact constant states of the patches with the modified rigidities (any correct element reproduces them): membrane N = C' eps with C' = E t/(1 - nu^2) [[a, nu sqrt(a b), 0], [nu sqrt(a b), b, 0], [0, 0, (1 - nu)/2 c]] (a, b, c = f11, f22, f12 of section times area); plate BEND kx = M11 / (D m11 (1 - nu^2)), ky = -nu sqrt(m11 / m22) kx, w = (kx x^2 + ky y^2)/2; TWIST w = P x y / (2 D (1 - nu) m12). Statics (load totals) for the thick plate, slab and wall.
